input.command: Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Id,ProcessName,@{n='MB';e={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' -and $_.WorkingSetSize -gt 300MB } | ForEach-Object { "$($_.ProcessId) $([math]::Round($_.WorkingSetSize/1MB))MB $($_.CommandLine.Substring(0,[math]::Min(140,$_.CommandLine.Length)))" }
input.description: Find what is using memory right now
